text.tspan: Region: eastus | All PaaS public access Disabled — reached via Private Endpoint + Private DNS | Entra ID / Workload Identity throughout
AKS — Azure CNI Overlay + Cilium | Istio mesh | KEDA + VPA | Workload Identity | AzureLinux | 3x D4s_v3 (autoscale)
pe-subnet (.4/24) — Private Endpoints (11) + Private DNS Zones (10)
Cosmos containers: Users, Accounts, Transactions, Transfers,
Foundry agent egress via Microsoft-Managed VNet (no customer subnet);
AI Foundry project hosts the chatbot, anomaly, budget &
account-opening agents consumed by the AKS services.
Icons: official Microsoft Azure architecture icon set
Notes: AKS API server IP-restricted; local accounts disabled.
Telemetry: OMS agent + OTEL to Log Analytics / App Insights.
ACR public access enabled (Premium) + private endpoint.
